record.original_title: Сунъий интеллектни қўллаш орқали юзага келадиган муносабатлар тартибга солиниши муносабати билан Ўзбекистон Республикасининг айрим қонун ҳужжатларига қўшимча ва ўзгартиришлар киритиш тўғрисида / О внесении дополнений и изменений в некоторые законодательные акты Республики Узбекистан в связи с регулированием отношений, возникающих при применении искусственного интеллекта
record.summary: Uzbekistan's first AI legislation, enacted as amendments to existing laws rather than a standalone AI act. It adds to the Law on Informatization a definition of artificial intelligence and a new Article 7-1: information resources and systems built on AI must not harm a person's life, health, freedom, honour, dignity or other rights, and legally significant decisions affecting human rights and freedoms may not rest solely on their outputs. It adds AI-related tasks for the competent state body and an administrative fine of 50 to 100 base units for unlawful processing of personal data using AI.
record.notes: Adopted by the Legislative Chamber on 12 August 2025, approved by the Senate on 1 November 2025 and signed on 21 January 2026, the date lex.uz gives as entry into force (Article 4 provides for entry into force on official publication). The Cabinet of Ministers is told to align government resolutions with the law, have ministries revoke conflicting acts and explain the law to the public. The Legislative Chamber's explanatory note says the law sets general foundations for AI use and clarifies the powers of the competent state body.

verification.note: lex.uz Russian text (document 8011377), the Uzbek Cyrillic text (8008401) and the English card page (8011930, title and signature only, saying the text is given in Uzbek and Russian) were stored; the Russian text confirmed title, number, adoption and approval dates, signature date, entry-into-force date, Article 7-1, the AI definition and the fine. The English title comes from the card page. No labelling requirement appears in the stored text; press reports on the first-reading draft mentioned one and are not relied on.
